refusals.message: the 'node:vm' module (it compiles and runs JavaScript source at runtime, and a compiled binary embeds no JavaScript engine to run it) is not supported yet
the 'node:inspector' module (it drives the V8 inspector protocol — debugger, profiler, heap access — and a compiled binary embeds no V8 engine to inspect) is not supported yet
the 'node:sqlite' module (it wraps the SQLite library bundled into the node executable, and scriptc binaries bundle no SQLite engine) is not supported yet
the 'domain' module (deprecated in Node and slated for removal; its implicit error interception hooks every async callback at engine level, which is not modeled) is not supported yet
the '_http_agent' module (a Node-internal module: it exposes Node's own implementation objects, which the scriptc runtime does not replicate) is not supported yet
the 'node:repl' module is not supported yet
